paper.title_en: Inflaton accretion onto primordial black holes during reheating
paper.abstract_en: Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) forming prior to Big Bang Nucleosynthesis evolve during the reheating epoch, an environment dominated by an oscillating inflaton field decaying into a relativistic thermal bath. In this work, we track the complete lifecycle of PBHs within this coupled inflaton-radiation background. Utilizing $α$-attractor E-models, we analytically anchor the reheating initial conditions directly to Cosmic Microwave Background observations. By matching exact scalar field solutions in a Schwarzschild spacetime to the cosmological far-zone, we derive the cycle-averaged mass accretion rate and couple it to the growing radiation bath. We find that this combined accretion induces a highly non-linear enhancement of the final PBH mass. Because the Hawking evaporation timescale scales cubically with mass, PBHs forming near their critical runaway limits experience a massive extension of their lifespans. Surviving deeper into the radiation-dominated era triggers a multi-order-of-magnitude amplification in their emitted Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background (SGWB).

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文将原初黑洞在重加热时期的吸积与最终随机引力波背景的放大联系起来，直接涉及脉冲星计时阵列所探测的随机引力波背景信号源，理论框架具体且与观测锚定，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 重加热时期暴胀子对原初黑洞的吸积
decision.abstract_zh: 在大爆炸核合成之前形成的原初黑洞（PBHs）会在重加热时期演化，该环境由振荡的暴胀子场主导，该场衰变为相对论性热浴。在这项工作中，我们在耦合的暴胀子-辐射背景中追踪了PBHs的完整生命周期。利用 $\alpha$-吸引子E-模型，我们将重加热初始条件直接解析地锚定到宇宙微波背景观测。通过将Schwarzschild时空中的精确标量场解与宇宙学远区匹配，我们推导了周期平均的质量吸积率，并将其与增长的辐射浴耦合。我们发现，这种组合吸积会导致最终PBH质量的高度非线性增强。由于Hawking蒸发时标与质量成三次方关系，接近临界失控极限形成的PBHs会经历寿命的大幅延长。存活到辐射主导时代更深阶段，会触发其发射的随机引力波背景（SGWB）被放大多个数量级。
